articles.title_en: Information Frictions and Skill Signaling in the Youth Labor Market
articles.title_cn: 青年劳动力市场中的信息摩擦与技能信号
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence that information frictions limit the labor market trajectories of US youth. We provide credible skill signals—recommendation letters based on supervisor feedback—to a random subset of 43,409 participants in New York’s summer jobs program. Letters increase employment the following year by 3 percentage points (4.5 percent). Earnings effects grow over four years to a cumulative $1,349 (4.9 percent). We find little evidence of increased job search or confidence; instead, signals may help employers better identify successful matches with high-productivity workers. Pulling youth into the labor market can, however, hamper on-time graduation, especially among low-achieving students. (JEL D82, H75, J13, J24, J31, J64)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了信息摩擦限制美国青年劳动力市场轨迹的证据。我们向纽约暑期就业项目中随机抽取的43,409名参与者提供了可信的技能信号——基于主管反馈的推荐信。信件使次年就业率提高了3个百分点（4.5%）。收入效应在四年内累积增长至1,349美元（4.9%）。我们几乎没有发现求职活动或信心增强的证据；相反，信号可能帮助雇主更好地识别与高生产率工人的成功匹配。然而，将青年拉入劳动力市场可能会阻碍按时毕业，尤其是在低成就学生中。（JEL D82, H75, J13, J24, J31, J64）

articles.title_en: High Schools Tailored to Adults Can Help Them Complete a Traditional Diploma and Excel in the Labor Market
articles.title_cn: 为成人量身定制的高中可帮助他们完成传统文凭并在劳动力市场中表现出色
articles.abstract_en: Over 18 million adults in the United States lack a high school credential. While some go on to attain the GED, diplomas are potentially more valuable. A network of high schools helps adults graduate by providing tailored curricula, nonacademic coaching, onsite child care, and transportation. After five years, earnings increase by 38 percent more for graduates than nonenrolling applicants. We address selection by conditioning on preapplication earnings and comparing to students who exit after positive shocks. Much of the wage gains can be accounted for by sectoral switching and evidence on credential completions is consistent with a human capital mechanism. (JEL I21, I26, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 美国有超过18万成年人缺乏高中文凭。虽然有些人继续获得GED，但文凭可能更有价值。一个高中网络通过提供量身定制的课程、非学业辅导、现场儿童保育和交通服务，帮助成年人毕业。五年后，毕业生的收入比未入学的申请者高出38%。我们通过根据申请前收入进行条件调整，并与在正向冲击后退出的学生进行比较来解决选择性问题。大部分工资增长可以由部门转换来解释，而关于文凭完成的证据与人力资本机制一致。(JEL I21, I26, J24, J31)

articles.title_en: Pricing Carbon: Evidence from Expert Recommendations
articles.title_cn: 碳定价：来自专家建议的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the variation of carbon price recommendations and their determinants using survey evidence from more than 400 experts across almost 40 countries. We quantify the extent of disagreement and reveal that a majority of experts can agree on short- and medium-term global carbon price levels, and on unilateral carbon price levels in most countries. The majority of recommendations do not exhibit a “ free riding” pattern of lower unilateral than global carbon prices. Furthermore, border carbon adjustment facilitates higher unilateral price recommendations. We show how recommendations vary with additional survey responses, and with country and expert characteristics. (JEL H43, Q54, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用来自近40个国家400多位专家的调查证据，研究碳价格建议的差异及其决定因素。我们量化了分歧的程度，并揭示出大多数专家能够在短期和中期全球碳价格水平以及大多数国家的单边碳价格水平上达成一致。大多数建议并未表现出“搭便车”模式，即单边碳价格低于全球碳价格。此外，边境碳调整促进了更高的单边价格建议。我们展示了建议如何随额外的调查回应以及国家和专家特征而变化。(JEL H43, Q54, Q58)

articles.title_en: Real-Time Pricing and the Cost of Clean Power
articles.title_cn: 实时定价与清洁电力成本
articles.abstract_en: Solar and wind power are now cheaper than fossil fuels but are intermittent. The extra supply-side variability implies growing benefits of using real-time retail pricing (RTP). We evaluate the potential gains of RTP using a model that jointly solves investment, supply, storage, and demand to obtain a chronologically detailed dynamic equilibrium for the island of Oahu, Hawai‘i. We find that, holding demand assumptions fixed, RTP reduces costs in high-renewable systems by roughly 6 to 12 times as much as in fossil systems, markedly lowering the cost of clean energy integration. (JEL G31, L94, L98, Q42, Q48)
articles.abstract_cn: 太阳能和风能现在比化石燃料更便宜，但它们是间歇性的。额外的供应侧可变性意味着使用实时零售定价（RTP）的收益越来越大。我们使用一个联合求解投资、供应、存储和需求的模型来评估RTP的潜在收益，从而获得夏威夷瓦胡岛的时间详细动态均衡。我们发现，在保持需求假设不变的情况下，RTP在高可再生能源系统中降低的成本大约是化石燃料系统的6到12倍，显著降低了清洁能源整合的成本。（JEL G31, L94, L98, Q42, Q48）

articles.title_cn: 法院决策中的身份认同
articles.abstract_en: We explore the role of identity along multiple dimensions in high-stakes decision-making. Our data contain information about demographic and socioeconomic indicators for defendants and randomly assigned jurors in a Swedish court. Our results show that defendants are 4 to 6 percent less likely to get a prison sentence if judged by one more juror belonging to the same identity-forming group. Moreover, they are given 10 percent shorter prison sentences. Socioeconomic background and demographic attributes are equally important for identity effects, and these effects stem from trials of longer duration and where the defendant is present in the courtroom. (JEL D91, J15, J16, K42, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了身份认同在高风险决策中沿多个维度所起的作用。我们的数据包含瑞典法院中被告和随机分配的陪审员的人口统计和社会经济指标信息。我们的结果表明，如果由多一位属于同一身份形成群体的陪审员审理，被告获得监禁判决的可能性会降低4至6%。此外，他们被判处更短的监禁刑期，缩短了10%。社会经济背景和人口统计特征对身份效应同样重要，且这些效应源于持续时间较长以及被告出庭的审判。(JEL D91, J15, J16, K42, Z13)

articles.title_en: The School-to-Prison Pipeline: Long-Run Impacts of School Suspensions on Adult Crime
articles.title_cn: 从学校到监狱的管道：学校停学对成年犯罪的长期影响
articles.abstract_en: Schools must balance student behavior management with the potential negatives of strict discipline. These policies can deter misbehavior but may stigmatize students and expose them to the criminal justice system early. We assess the impact of attending a strict discipline school on achievement, educational attainment, and adult criminal activity. Using data from a boundary change and principal switches, we find that higher suspension rates have significant negative long-term effects. Students at such schools are 15–20 percent more likely to be arrested and incarcerated as adults. Negative impacts on educational attainment are particularly pronounced for males and students of color. (JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 学校必须在学生行为管理与严格纪律的潜在负面影响之间取得平衡。这些政策可以阻止不当行为，但可能使学生蒙受污名，并使其过早接触刑事司法系统。我们评估了就读于纪律严格的学校对学业成绩、教育程度和成年犯罪活动的影响。利用边界变化和校长更替的数据，我们发现较高的停学率具有显著的长期负面效应。此类学校的学生成年后被逮捕和监禁的可能性高出15-20%。对教育程度的负面影响在男性和有色人种学生中尤为明显。（JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, K42）

articles.title_en: Downward Revision of Investment Decisions after Corporate Tax Hikes
articles.title_cn: 企业税上调后投资决策的下调修正
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal effect of corporate tax hikes on firm investment based on more than 1,400 local tax changes. By observing planned and realized investment volumes in a representative sample of German manufacturing firms, we can study how tax hikes induce firms to revise their investment decisions. On average, the share of firms that invest less than previously planned increases by 3 percentage points after a tax hike. This effect is twice as large during recessions. (JEL D22, E32, G31, H25, H32, H71, L60)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于超过1,400次地方税变化，估计了企业税上调对企业投资的因果效应。通过观察德国制造业企业代表性样本中的计划投资额和实际投资额，我们可以研究税收上调如何促使企业修正其投资决策。平均而言，在税收上调后，投资低于先前计划的企业比例增加了3个百分点。这一效应在经济衰退期间是两倍大。（JEL D22, E32, G31, H25, H32, H71, L60）

articles.title_en: Managers’ Productivity and Recruitment in the Public Sector
articles.title_cn: 公共部门管理者的生产率与招聘
articles.abstract_en: Governments face many constraints in attracting talented managers to the public sector, which often lacks high-powered incentives. In this paper, we study how a civil service reform in Chile changed the effectiveness of a vital group of public sector managers: school principals. First, we estimate principal effectiveness by using an extension of the canonical teacher value-added model. Then we evaluate the effect of the reform on principal effectiveness using a difference-in-differences approach. We find that public schools appointed more effective managers and improved their students’ outcomes after increasing the competitiveness and transparency of their selection process. (JEL D73, H83, I21, J24, J45, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 政府在吸引有才能的管理者进入公共部门方面面临许多约束，而公共部门往往缺乏高能激励。在本文中，我们研究了智利的一项公务员制度改革如何改变了公共部门管理者中一个关键群体的有效性：学校校长。首先，我们通过扩展经典的教师增值模型来估计校长的有效性。然后，我们使用双重差分方法评估改革对校长有效性的影响。我们发现，在提高选拔过程的竞争性和透明度之后，公立学校任命了更有效的管理者，并改善了学生的成绩。（JEL D73, H83, I21, J24, J45, O15）

articles.title_en: How Do You Say Your Name? Difficult-to-Pronounce Names and Labor Market Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 你的名字怎么念？难发音的名字与劳动力市场结果
articles.abstract_en: We test for labor market discrimination based on an understudied characteristic: name fluency. Analysis of recent economics PhD job candidates indicates that name difficulty is negatively related to the probability of landing an academic or tenure-track position and research productivity of initial institutional placement. Discrimination due to name fluency is also found using experimental data from prior audit studies. Within samples of African Americans (Bertrand and Mullainathan 2004) and ethnic immigrants (Oreopoulos 2011), job applicants with less fluent names experience lower callback rates, and name complexity explains roughly between 10 and 50 percent of ethnic name penalties. The results are primarily driven by candidates with weaker résumés, suggesting that cognitive biases may contribute to the penalty of having a difficult-to-pronounce name. (JEL A11, J15, J23, J44, J71)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于一个研究不足的特征——名字流畅度——来检验劳动力市场歧视。对近期经济学博士求职者的分析表明，名字难度与获得学术或终身教职职位的概率以及初始机构安置的研究生产力呈负相关。使用先前审计研究的实验数据也发现了因名字流畅度而产生的歧视。在非裔美国人（Bertrand和Mullainathan 2004）和族裔移民（Oreopoulos 2011）的样本中，名字流畅度较低的求职者获得的回电率较低，而名字复杂度大约解释了族裔名字惩罚的10至50%%。结果主要由简历较弱的候选人驱动，这表明认知偏差可能助长了难发音名字的惩罚。（JEL A11, J15, J23, J44, J71）

articles.title_en: Achieving Air Pollution Control Targets with Technology‑Aided Monitoring: Better Enforcement or Localized Efforts?
articles.title_cn: 借助技术辅助监测实现空气污染控制目标：更好的执法还是局部努力？
articles.abstract_en: Weak enforcement of environmental regulations remains a global issue due to inadequate monitoring and misaligned incentives. This paper examines the effects of automated monitoring on achieving air pollution control targets amidst China’s war on pollution. Utilizing the staggered rollout process and remote-sensing data, we find local governments respond to the advanced monitoring system by strategically targeting areas near monitors, resulting in a 3.2 percent decrease in pollution adjacent to automated monitors compared to areas farther away. Furthermore, we observe heterogeneity in response across cities with varying degrees of preexisting data manipulation and among officials facing different incentives and public pressure. (JEL O13, O18, P25, P28, Q53, Q55, R11)
articles.abstract_cn: 由于监测不足和激励错位，环境法规执行不力仍是一个全球性问题。本文考察了自动化监测在中国治污攻坚战中实现空气污染控制目标的效果。利用分阶段推广过程和遥感数据，我们发现地方政府对先进监测系统的回应是战略性地瞄准监测点附近的区域，导致自动化监测点附近的污染比更远区域下降3.2%。此外，我们观察到在不同程度的事先数据操纵的城市以及面临不同激励和公众压力的官员之间存在异质性反应。(JEL O13, O18, P25, P28, Q53, Q55, R11)

articles.title_en: Administrative Burden and Procedural Denials: Experimental Evidence from SNAP
articles.title_cn: 行政负担与程序性拒绝：来自SNAP的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Many government program applications result in procedural denials due to administrative burdens associated with applying. We identify the intake interview as a key barrier to take-up of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and study the effect of an alternative application process designed to reduce burdens. Using a field experiment involving 65,000 Los Angeles applicants, we find that access to flexible interviews initiated by the applicant increases approvals by 6 percentage points, doubles early approvals, and increases long-term participation by over 2 percentage points. Our findings highlight the importance of incorporating flexibility when designing program integrity policies to minimize procedural denials. (JEL H75, I18, I38)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多政府项目申请因申请过程中的行政负担而导致程序性拒绝。我们确定 intake 访谈是补充营养援助计划参与的一个关键障碍，并研究了一种旨在减少负担的替代申请流程的效果。通过一项涉及 65,000 名洛杉矶申请人的现场实验，我们发现，由申请人发起的灵活访谈可增加 6 个百分点的批准率，使早期批准翻倍，并将长期参与率提高超过 2 个百分点。我们的研究结果强调了在设计项目诚信政策时纳入灵活性以最小化程序性拒绝的重要性。(JEL H75, I18, I38)

articles.title_en: Education and Geographical Mobility: The Role of the Job Surplus
articles.title_cn: 教育与地理流动性：工作盈余的作用
articles.abstract_en: Better educated workers accept many more long-distance job offers, and relocate quicker following local shocks. I attribute this to a fundamental feature of their labor market experience, unrelated to geography: large returns to job match quality. If a good offer happens to originate from far away, the match surplus is then more likely to justify the cost of moving. This “lubricates” labor markets spatially. Using wage transition data (and a jobs ladder model), I show this can explain the bulk of mobility differentials. These differentials can be closed by subsidizing long-distance matches, and I quantify the cost of doing so. (JEL I26, J24, J41, J61, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 受教育程度更高的工人会接受更多远距离工作机会，并在本地冲击后更快地搬迁。我将此归因于他们劳动力市场经验的一个基本特征，与地理无关：工作匹配质量的高回报。如果一个好的机会恰好来自远方，那么匹配盈余就更有可能证明搬迁成本的合理性。这在空间上“润滑”了劳动力市场。利用工资转换数据（以及工作阶梯模型），我表明这可以解释流动性差异的大部分。这些差异可以通过补贴远距离匹配来消除，我量化了这样做的成本。（JEL I26, J24, J41, J61, R23）

articles.title_en: Algorithmic Risk Assessment in the Hands of Humans
articles.title_cn: 人类手中的算法风险评估
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the impacts of adopting algorithmic risk assessments in sentencing. We find that judges changed sentencing practices in response to the risk assessment, but that discretion played a large role in mediating its impact. Judges deviated from the recommendations associated with the algorithm in systematic ways, suggestive of alternative objectives. As a result, risk assessment did not lead to detectable gains in terms of public safety or reduced incarceration rates. Using simulations, we show that strict adherence to the sentencing recommendations associated with the algorithm would have had benefits (less incarceration) but also some costs (increased sentences for youth). (JEL D81, D91, H76, K41, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了在量刑中采用算法风险评估的影响。我们发现，法官因应风险评估而改变了量刑实践，但自由裁量权在调节其影响方面发挥了重要作用。法官以系统性的方式偏离与算法相关的建议，这暗示了其他目标的存在。因此，风险评估并未在公共安全或降低监禁率方面带来可检测的收益。通过模拟，我们表明严格遵守与算法相关的量刑建议本可带来好处（减少监禁），但也带来一些成本（对青少年增加刑罚）。（JEL D81, D91, H76, K41, K42）

articles.title_en: The Carrot and the Stick: Bank Bailouts and the Disciplining Role of Board Appointments
articles.title_cn: 胡萝卜与大棒：银行救助与董事会任命的纪律作用
articles.abstract_en: We empirically examine the Capital Purchase Program (CPP) used by the US government to bail out distressed banks and its implications for regulatory policy. We find strong evidence that a feature of the CPP—the government’s ability to appoint independent directors on the board of an assisted bank that missed six dividend payments to the Treasury—had a significant effect on bank behavior. Banks were averse to these appointments—the empirical distribution of missed payments exhibits a sharp discontinuity at five. Director appointments by the Treasury were associated with improved bank performance and lower CEO pay. (JEL G21, G28, G32, G34, G35, G38, H81)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们实证研究了美国政府用于救助陷入困境银行的资本购买计划（CPP）及其对监管政策的影响。我们发现强有力的证据表明，CPP的一个特征——政府有能力在未向财政部支付六次股息的受助银行董事会中任命独立董事——对银行行为产生了显著影响。银行对这些任命持反感态度——未支付股息的实证分布在五次处出现明显的不连续性。财政部的董事任命与银行绩效改善和CEO薪酬降低相关。（JEL G21, G28, G32, G34, G35, G38, H81）

articles.title_en: Price Sensitivity and Information Barriers to the Take-Up of Naloxone
articles.title_cn: 纳洛酮使用中的价格敏感性与信息障碍
articles.abstract_en: We conducted a field experiment that randomized advertisements, advertisement content, and prices across 2,204 counties in the United States to study the impacts on online purchases of naloxone, an opioid overdose reversal drug. Advertising increased web-site users but only impacted purchases when combined with a price reduction. Messages emphasizing the discreet nature of online sales had no additional impact on purchases. Comparing counties with advertisements featuring a highly discounted price to those featuring the full price, we estimate a price elasticity of demand for online naloxone of −1.3. Price is a significant barrier to online purchases of this lifesaving medication. (JEL C93, H75, I12, I18, L65, M37)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在美国2,204个县进行了一项实地实验，随机分配广告、广告内容和价格，以研究对纳洛酮（一种阿片类药物过量逆转药物）在线购买的影响。广告增加了网站用户，但只有在与降价相结合时才影响购买。强调在线销售隐蔽性的信息对购买没有额外影响。比较以大幅折扣价格为特色的广告县与以全价为特色的广告县，我们估计在线纳洛酮的需求价格弹性为−1.3。价格是这种救命药物在线购买的重要障碍。(JEL C93, H75, I12, I18, L65, M37)

articles.title_en: Remote Instruction and Student Mental Health: Swedish Evidence from the Pandemic
articles.title_cn: 远程教学与学生心理健康：来自瑞典大流行的证据
articles.abstract_en: When COVID-19 reached Sweden, upper-secondary students (ages 17–19) transitioned to remote instruction, while lower-secondary schools (ages 14–16) remained open. We use this setting as a natural experiment to analyze how modes of instruction affect student mental health. We find a 4.4 percent decrease in mental health care use from remote instruction, primarily due to fewer diagnoses and prescriptions for depression and anxiety. The reduction persists throughout the study period; 21 months after the initial closure and 9 months after schools resumed usual operations. This suggests potential mental health benefits from remote instruction, at least in the medium term. (JEL I12, I18, I21, I28, I31)
articles.abstract_cn: 当COVID-19到达瑞典时，高中学生（年龄17-19岁）转为远程教学，而初中（年龄14-16岁）仍保持开放。我们利用这一情境作为自然实验，分析教学模式如何影响学生心理健康。我们发现远程教学使心理健康护理使用减少了4.4%，主要归因于抑郁和焦虑的诊断和处方减少。这一减少在整个研究期间持续存在；在最初关闭后的21个月和学校恢复正常运营后的9个月。这表明远程教学可能对心理健康有益，至少在中期内如此。（JEL I12, I18, I21, I28, I31）
